subject: Activation delegation & procurement checklist for Edgewave pilot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@edgewave.com>, Alex Santos <alex.santos@edgewave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Activation delegation & procurement checklist for Edgewave pilot

Hi Julia / Alex —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Below is a concise recap of agreed success criteria, the proposed evaluation plan/timeline, and a first-pass RACI for the pilot handoffs. Please confirm or flag any missing owners so we can lock the kickoff next week.

Quick recap (what we heard)
- Goal: validate 3M monthly inference tokens at <150ms p50 for customer-facing search ranking use case.
- Success criteria: latency targets, throughput under 3 concurrent prod-like streams, and accuracy delta within 1.5% of existing ranker on the core dataset.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (Aug 23): Kickoff + infra access (VPC peering / IP allowlist).
- Week 1–2: Ingest sample data + baseline run (off-peak).
- Week 3: Load test at target concurrency, monitor tail latencies and throughput.
- Week 4: Final validation and handoff to app owners.

RACI (first draft)
- Redwood infra setup (dedicated): Responsible = mina_haddad; Accountable = rishi_malhotra; Consulted = Edgewave infra (Alex); Informed = Lauren.
- Application integration (client SDK + retry logic): Responsible = Alex (Edgewave); Accountable = Julia (Edgewave); Consulted = mina_haddad; Informed = Lauren.
- Security review & data controls (VPC, KMS): Responsible = Alex; Accountable = Mark (procurement/security at Edgewave); Consulted = rishi_malhotra; Informed = Mina.
- Procurement & SSO tests: Responsible = Mark (Edgewave); Accountable = Julia; Consulted = Rishi; Informed = Mina/LAuren.

Open items / asks for you
1) Confirm the primary infra contact (we have Alex) and procurement contact (Mark).
2) Share VPN/VPC peering CIDR and an admin account for initial tests by Aug 21.
3) Accept the attached scope doc (redwood_activation_scope_v1.pdf) or send edits.

Next steps (our side)
- I will provision a dedicated test pool and share connection instructions once we get the network details.
- Rishi will draft a lightweight SOW for the pilot pricing (will follow in a separate thread).

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Aug 23 at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: redwood_activation_scope_v1.pdf (outline of pilot scope and metrics), edgewave_env_requirements.xlsx (network/endpoint checklist)

Subject: Re: Activation delegation & procurement checklist for Edgewave pilot

Thanks Mina — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications:

- Success criteria: the team would like an explicit definition for the accuracy delta test (is that top-10 NDCG or pairwise score?). Can you propose the exact metric in the scope doc?
- Timeline: Aug 23 kickoff is good. Procurement will need ~5 business days to approve the SOW once we receive it.
- Owners: Confirmed — Alex is infra lead, Mark is procurement/security. I (Julia) will be accountable for application validation.

Network details: I’ll have our infra team send VPC peering CIDR and a short connectivity checklist by EOD Aug 18.

On attachments: we reviewed the scope PDF quickly — the latency targets look reasonable. Please add the NDCG metric and a checkpoint at Week 2 for a model-quality sanity check.

—Julia
Julia Park
CTO, Edgewave Systems
julia@edgewave.com

Julia — thanks. Attached is an updated scope that includes the explicit metric language we discussed (top-10 NDCG with a <1.5% delta target) and a Week 2 quality gate. I’ve also embedded a lightweight RACI table in the doc; below is the short version for quick visibility.

Updated RACI highlights (concise)
- Dedicated Redwood test pool (network + access): R = Mina, A = Rishi, C = Alex, I = Julia.
- Client SDK & integration work: R = Alex, A = Julia, C = Mina, I = Rishi.
- Security & keys (KMS + audit logs): R = Alex, A = Mark, C = Rishi, I = Mina.
- Procurement signoff & SOW countersign: R = Mark, A = Julia, C = Rishi/Mina, I = Lauren.

Procurement notes from our side (Rishi)
- Rishi will send a draft one-page SOW and a pilot pricing schedule by EOD tomorrow (Aug 19).
- Edgewave asked about a short-term credit or trial discount for the pilot — I will propose a 30% pilot credit on baseline usage to cover onboarding testing.

Can we lock the kickoff for Aug 23, 10am PT? I’ll send the calendar invite once we have a final confirmation and the connectivity info.

Best,
Mina

Attachments: redwood_activation_scope_v1.pdf (v1.1 — added NDCG clause)

Quick procurement update — sending the one-page SOW and the pilot pricing schedule as promised. Key points:

- If Edgewave needs an MSA amendment for data residency, we can surface legal review within 5 business days.

Action: Mark / Julia, please confirm procurement OK with net 30 + SOW sign-off timeline so we can have contracts ready before the Aug 23 kickoff.
